Title: Select Batch Pool autoscale service-defined variables will be retired on 31 March 2024

Body.Content:
To help improve lookback windows and reliability of broadly used autoscale metrics, select autoscale service-defined variables with limited usage will be retired on 31 March 2024. The service-defined variables that will be retired are: WallClockSeconds, MemoryBytes, DiskBytes, DiskReadBytes, DiskWriteBytes, DiskReadOps, DiskWriteOps, NetworkInBytes, NetworkOutBytes, and SampleNodeCount. 

Required action 

Please remove references in your autoscale formula for the service-defined variables that will be retired on 31 March 2024. 

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
